title: The Fake Job Interview That Cost Binance $6 Billion
description:
A recruiter, a video interview and a test assignment: everything looked like an ordinary job opportunity. But the company didn't exist — and the code opened a path into Binance.

This is the story of how a fake interview led to compromised wallet approvals and a crypto theft Binance estimated at about $6.34 billion. About $2.85 billion was frozen or intercepted; that doesn't necessarily mean it was returned.

00:00 A job interview that wasn't real
00:20 How the trap worked
00:33 Malware enters Binance
00:59 The transfers begin
